# CyberPanel

> The world's fastest free control panel powered by OpenLiteSpeed. 10x faster, built-in caching, free SSL, Docker apps.

## Products

- [Global Edge Cache for Faster Websites](https://cyberpanel.net/edge-cache): Speed up websites with CyberPanel Edge: multi-region full-page caching, health-aware routing, reviewed DNS changes, and a free plan.
- [Cloud VPS](https://cyberpanel.net/cloud-vps): Professional-grade cloud infrastructure with hourly billing, premium CyberPanel templates, and enterprise performance. Scale instantly, pay only for what you
- [Managed Vultr Cloud Servers with CyberPanel](https://cyberpanel.net/vultr-cloud): Live Vultr plans with CyberPanel, premium modules, and managed deployment.
- [Email Delivery Service](https://cyberpanel.net/email-delivery-service): Purpose-built C email server — not a wrapper around Postfix or a third-party service. Full control over every connection, every packet.
- [Managed WordPress Hosting](https://cyberpanel.net/managed-wordpress-hosting): Managed WordPress hosting on OpenLiteSpeed with full Apache .htaccess compatibility: your existing rules keep working. Daily backups and a free domain included.
- [DNS Hosting - Free Global DNS Network](https://cyberpanel.net/dns-hosting): Free DNS hosting on CyberPanel's global DNS network: add a domain, point it at our nameservers, and manage records from the dashboard or the API.
- [CyberPanel Website Backups With Safe & Easy Data Protection](https://cyberpanel.net/website-backup): CyberPanel's one-click website backups ensure your data is safely protected. Enjoy automated, secure backups with simple restoration and varied storage options.
- [CyberPanel Secure VPN Service - Privacy & Freedom](https://cyberpanel.net/cyberpanel-secure-vpn-service-privacy-freedom): CyberVPN from CyberPanel: a WireGuard VPN with a free plan of 30 GB a month, an Android app and seven server locations. No card needed to start.
- [High-Availability WordPress Hosting](https://cyberpanel.net/high-availability-wordpress-hosting): Your site runs on a redundant cluster — multiple web servers, a 3-node database, and replicated storage. If any server fails, traffic reroutes
- [Managed n8n Hosting](https://cyberpanel.net/managed-n8n-hosting): Powerful workflow automation made simple. Connect your apps, automate tedious tasks, and save hours every week - all with our managed N8N hosting.
- [Managed Email Service](https://cyberpanel.net/managed-email-service): Managed SMTP service for sending email from your sites and apps: delivery on our infrastructure, a free plan to start, and help from our team.
- [Litespeed Enterprise Get Started](https://cyberpanel.net/litespeed-enterprise-get-started): LiteSpeed Enterprise licenses for CyberPanel: plans by domains, memory and PHP workers, and a comparison with OpenLiteSpeed.

## Control panel features

- [CyberPanel - Free Web Hosting Control Panel](https://cyberpanel.net/): The world's fastest free control panel powered by OpenLiteSpeed. 10x faster, built-in caching, free SSL, Docker apps.
- [Get Started with CyberPanel](https://cyberpanel.net/get-started-with-cyberpanel): CyberPanel makes it easy to focus on your website, while it takes care of your server administration. Security, Stability and Updates, CyberPanel handles it
- [WordPress Manager for CyberPanel: Staging, Backups, Updates](https://cyberpanel.net/cyberpanel-wordpress-manager): Install, stage, back up and update WordPress sites from CyberPanel, with one-click staging environments and instant admin access.
- [Docker Manager: Streamline Container Placement Easily](https://cyberpanel.net/docker-manager): Boost efficiency with our Docker manager. Optimize Docker container placement and streamline your management tasks for better performance.
- [n8n Manager: One-Click Workflow Automation](https://cyberpanel.net/n8n-manager): Deploy n8n from CyberPanel in one click, with the database, SSL certificate and Docker container set up for you.
- [CyberPanel Multi-Server Manager: Every Server, One Panel](https://cyberpanel.net/multi-server-manager): Manage your other CyberPanel servers from one controller. $49 per year or $149 lifetime. One license per controller IP; managed servers need no license.
- [Replace Apache with OpenLiteSpeed on Any Panel](https://cyberpanel.net/cyberpanel-openlitespeed): Switch a Plesk or cPanel server from Apache to OpenLiteSpeed with one free installer that detects your panel and configures it for you.
- [CyberPanel .htaccess Module](https://cyberpanel.net/cyberpanel-htaccess-module): Make Apache .htaccess files work on OpenLiteSpeed: PHP settings, headers, redirects, access control and WordPress brute-force protection.
- [Features](https://cyberpanel.net/features): CyberPanel 3.0 features: websites, email, DNS, databases, backups and free SSL in a free, open-source control panel built on OpenLiteSpeed.
- [CyberPanel: Free Web Hosting Control Panel for All](https://cyberpanel.net/hosting-control-panel): Use the CyberPanel free web hosting control panel to easily deploy PHP-based applications on the cloud with one-click staging, transfer and automated backups.
- [Add-ons](https://cyberpanel.net/cyberpanel-addons): CyberPanel's core is free and open source. Premium add-ons add SSL V2, WordPress Manager Pro, Backup V2, an email debugger, a root file manager and Rspamd.
- [Your All-in-One CyberPanel WordPress Manager Tool](https://cyberpanel.net/wordpress-management-with-cyberpanel): Manage your WordPress site like a pro! Our WordPress Manager offers powerful features for effortless updates, security, and performance.
- [CyberPanel SSL Manager: Simplifies Management of SSL Certificates](https://cyberpanel.net/ssl-manager): The perfect feature of CyberPanel's SSL Manager is easy management of and use of SSL certificates. Securely manage your SSL certificates easily using CyberPanel's SSL Manager now!
- [CyberPanel Firewall Management | Top Managed Firewall Solution](https://cyberpanel.net/firewall-management): Protect your website with CyberPanel’s Firewall Management. Secure, cloud managed firewall solutions. Start your free trial today and enhance your site’s security!
- [CyberPanel FTP Manager | Best FTP Server Management Tool](https://cyberpanel.net/ftp-manager): Manage your files with ease using CyberPanel’s FTP Manager. Fast, secure file transfers and advanced FTP server management. Start your free trial today!
- [CyberPanel MySQL Manager | Top SQL Manager for MySQL](https://cyberpanel.net/mysql-manager): Optimize your databases with CyberPanel’s MySQL Manager. Secure, efficient management made easy. Start your free trial today and enhance your website’s performance!
- [Roundcube for CyberPanel](https://cyberpanel.net/roundcube): Roundcube webmail, managed in CyberPanel. Included with $169 lifetime Add-ons or $99 lifetime standalone for one server IP.

## Free tools

- [Free Load Testing: Test Website Performance](https://cyberpanel.net/load-testing): Free HTTP load testing: see how your site handles real traffic, with real-time metrics, percentile breakdowns and connection timing. No credit card.
- [Check DNS Records](https://cyberpanel.net/check-dns-records): DNS records contain precious information about your domain environment. CyberPanel’s DNS record checker is a quick diagnostic tool that allows you to verify
- [AI WordPress Scanner](https://cyberpanel.net/ai-wordpress-scanner): Scan a WordPress site for malware and vulnerable plugins with CyberPanel's AI scanner: see a live scan, what it checks, and what the free monthly scans include.
- [Boost Email Deliverability with CyberPanel's Mail Tester](https://cyberpanel.net/e-mail-tester): Test, validate, and optimize your email deliverability with CyberPanel Email Tester. Get detailed reports and boost email performance easily and efficiently.

## Documentation

- [Resources: Docs, Guides and Free Tools](https://cyberpanel.net/resources): CyberPanel documentation, blog, changelog and free tools: guides for installing and running your control panel, plus load, DNS and email testers.
- [Documentation](https://cyberpanel.net/KnowledgeBase/)
- [Blog](https://cyberpanel.net/blog)
- [Changelog](https://cyberpanel.net/KnowledgeBase/home/change-logs/)

## Company and support

- [Custom Development Services](https://cyberpanel.net/custom-development): Websites, web & mobile apps, and custom software, built and deployed on your CyberPanel server. Get a free quote.
- [Support](https://cyberpanel.net/support): Get help with CyberPanel: open a ticket, chat on WhatsApp or report a bug on GitHub, and see what to include so the first reply can solve it.
- [About Us](https://cyberpanel.net/about-us): The hosting panel that grew into a cloud platform. Free, open source, since 2017.
- [Contact Us](https://cyberpanel.net/contact-us): Contact the CyberPanel team: addresses for support, partnerships and sales, and a form for anything else. We reply by email.
- [Partners](https://cyberpanel.net/partners): Grow your hosting business with our powerful control panel. Choose the program that fits your needs and start earning today.
- [Become our Partner](https://cyberpanel.net/become-our-partner): The CyberPanel Partner Program for hosting providers, datacenters and resellers: bundle the control panel with your servers and lower licensing costs.
- [Affiliate Program](https://cyberpanel.net/affiliate-program): Join the CyberPanel Affiliate Program and earn generous commissions by referring customers to our cloud hosting platform.
- [Write For Us](https://cyberpanel.net/write-for-us): Write for the CyberPanel blog: the topics we accept, our guidelines, and a form to pitch your article to the editors.
- [Privacy Policy](https://cyberpanel.net/privacy-policy): How CyberPanel collects, uses and protects personal data on cyberpanel.net and its hosted services, and how to exercise your rights.

## Optional

- [Android App Development](https://cyberpanel.net/custom-development/android): Native & cross-platform Android apps with secure backends on your server.
- [Custom Software & API Development](https://cyberpanel.net/custom-development/custom-software): Bespoke web apps, SaaS platforms and APIs built in your stack by the CyberPanel development team. Tell us the scope and get a quote within one business day.
- [UI/UX Design Services](https://cyberpanel.net/custom-development/design): Product design, branding and design systems for web and mobile from the CyberPanel team. Share your brief and get a quote within one business day.
- [DevOps & Server Management](https://cyberpanel.net/custom-development/devops): Migrations, performance tuning, hardening and managed server operations.
- [iOS App Development](https://cyberpanel.net/custom-development/ios): iPhone and iPad app development from design to App Store release by the CyberPanel team. Share your idea and get a quote within one business day.
- [Website & WordPress Speed Optimization](https://cyberpanel.net/custom-development/speed-optimization): Core Web Vitals fixes, LiteSpeed cache tuning, image and database optimization with a before/after report.
- [Maintenance & Support](https://cyberpanel.net/custom-development/support): Updates, monitoring and on-call support for your sites and apps from the CyberPanel team. Tell us what you run and get a quote within one business day.
- [Website Development](https://cyberpanel.net/custom-development/web): Fast, responsive, SEO-ready websites designed, built and hosted by the CyberPanel team.
- [WordPress & WooCommerce Development](https://cyberpanel.net/custom-development/wordpress): Custom WordPress themes, plugins and WooCommerce stores tuned for LiteSpeed.
- [CyberPanel x CloudPages](https://cyberpanel.net/cyberpanel-x-cloudpages): Free ebook: how to deploy a fast WordPress site with CyberPanel on YouStable, step by step. Leave your email and we send the download link.
- [eBook](https://cyberpanel.net/ebook): Free ebook for agencies: understanding the WordPress content management system and how it helps in building client websites. Leave your email for the download link.
- [Partner Cyber Hosting](https://cyberpanel.net/partner-cyber-hosting): CyberHosting offers the LiteSpeed stack as a fully managed hosting service from the team behind CyberPanel: automatic SSL, staging, one-click VPS and a choice of panel.
- [Partner YouStable](https://cyberpanel.net/partner-youstable): YouStable, founded in 2015, is a web Hosting service provider that offers cutting-edge web solutions to StartUps, Bloggers, Web Developers, and other
- [Social Media Glossary](https://cyberpanel.net/social-media-glossary): Your complete guide to web hosting, server management, and CyberPanel terminology. Find definitions for all the technical terms you need to know.

Is CyberPanel free?

Yes. CyberPanel with OpenLiteSpeed is free and open source. Premium add-ons and hosted services are optional purchases.

Do I need my own server?

You can install CyberPanel on a compatible server you manage, right from your browser, or choose a cloud server from CyberPanel. The getting started guide explains both paths.

Can I move my existing websites?

Yes. The knowledge base includes migration guidance. Check the documentation for the route that matches your current hosting setup.

Where do I check supported operating systems?

Use the current installation guide for supported distributions, server requirements and setup steps.
